hero.title: Trusted Scientific Solutions for a Smarter, Safer World
hero.description: ADNGUARD certifies meat authenticity through independent DNA analysis. Protect your customers, strengthen your reputation.

fullTransparency.title: Full Transparency
fullTransparency.desc: We verify that establishments do not serve pork-based products.

labTesting.title: Laboratory Testing
labTesting.desc: Random meat samples are tested for pork contamination.

surpriseInspections.title: Surprise Inspections
surpriseInspections.desc: Our teams conduct unexpected visits to ensure compliance.

certification.title: Certification & Renewal
certification.desc: Establishments must renew certification to maintain status.

intro.subtitle: WHO WE ARE
intro.desc1: In recent years, numerous food scandals have shaken consumer confidence. The authenticity of meat products is no longer guaranteed by simple labeling.
intro.desc2: ADNGUARD was born from a simple mission: to use the power of DNA analysis to provide irrefutable proof of product composition and protect both consumers and honest professionals.

verification.title: Verification & Laboratory Testing
verification.desc: Meat samples are taken randomly and tested in certified laboratories to ensure compliance. If any trace of pork is found, the certification is immediately revoked.

inspection.title: Surprise Inspections
inspection.desc: Our teams perform unannounced inspections to verify that no pork-based products are present in the establishment. Refusal to allow an inspection can lead to loss of certification.

lookup.title: Online Certification Lookup
lookup.desc: Customers can easily check the current certification status of any establishment through an online system. Each business is assigned a unique certification ID.

video.subtitle: MEAT DNA TESTING
video.title: Fast And Safe Sample Collection Procedure For Analysis

whyChooseUs.subtitle: Why Choose Us
whyChooseUs.title:
WE PROVIDE HIGH QUALITY
AND ACCURACY
whyChooseUs.desc: Our laboratory is committed to delivering precise and reliable data to support your critical decisions. We combine scientific expertise with cutting-edge technology.

environmental.title: Environmental Testing
environmental.desc: Comprehensive analysis of soil and water using advanced DNA sequencing.

foodSafety.title: Food Safety
foodSafety.desc: Guaranteed detection of allergens and cross-contamination in food products.

technology.title: Advanced Technology
technology.desc: Using state-of-the-art NGS (Next Generation Sequencing) for rapid results.

automation.subtitle: Automation
automation.title:
THE HIGHEST STANDARDS
OF AUTOMATION
automation.desc: We have automated 90% of our analytical processes to reduce human error and increase throughput. From sample reception to result delivery, our workflow is seamless.

didYouKnow.title: Did you know?
didYouKnow.desc: Automated DNA extraction typically yields 30% higher purity than manual methods, ensuring more reliable downstream analysis.

gain.title: What You Gain
gain.subtitle: Tangible benefits for your business and your customers.

trust.title: Unshakable Trust
trust.desc: By displaying the ADNGUARD label, you prove to your customers that you have nothing to hide. You stand out from competitors who simply make claims without proof.

protection.title: Brand Protection
protection.desc: Protect your reputation from supply chain scandals. Our regular controls ensure that your suppliers remain compliant.

growth.title: Business Growth
growth.desc: Consumers are willing to pay more for certified quality. Increase your customer loyalty and attract new demanding clients.

about.heroTitle: Independent Verification for a Transparent Market
about.heroDesc: We restore trust between consumers and food professionals through irrefutable scientific proof.
about.missionDesc1: In a globalized market, food fraud is becoming increasingly common. Consumers have lost trust in labels and claims.
about.missionDesc2: ADNGUARD was born from a simple observation: only DNA provides absolute certainty about what we eat. We act as an independent third party to verify the authenticity of meat products.
about.networkDesc: We work with a network of ISO 17025 accredited laboratories across Europe to guarantee the highest reliability of results.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.subtitle: Have questions? We are here to help you.

footer.desc: Independent DNA control to certify meat authenticity. Protect your customers, strengthen your reputation.

offers.title: Choose Your Certification Level
offers.subtitle: Solutions adapted to every establishment, from local butchers to processing plants.

process.title: How It Works
process.subtitle: A rigorous and transparent process to guarantee product authenticity.

step1.title: Unannounced Sampling
step1.desc: An ADNGUARD agent visits without notice to collect a sealed sample.

step2.title: Lab Analysis
step2.desc: The sample is sent to a certified partner laboratory for DNA analysis.

step3.title: Multi-Species Analysis
step3.desc: Detection of pork, cat, dog, and other undeclared species traces.

step4.title: Certification & QR Code
step4.desc: If compliant: official report, ADNGUARD logo, and QR code verifiable by your customers.

transparency.title: Unannounced
transparency.desc: Our inspections are performed without notice to guarantee authentic results.

scientific.title: Scientific Proof
scientific.desc: DNA analysis is the only irrefutable proof of product composition.

independent.title: Independence
independent.desc: ADNGUARD is completely independent from the controlled establishments.

cta_section.title: Ready to Show Your Commitment to Quality?
cta_section.desc: Join the establishments that have chosen transparency. Get your ADNGUARD certification today.
cta_section.note: First test at a preferential rate • Logo offered if compliant

verification.subtitle: Enter the establishment's ADNGUARD code to verify its certification status and view DNA control history.
verification.searchHint: The code can be found on the ADNGUARD sticker displayed at the establishment or on the QR code.
verification.notFoundDesc: No establishment matches this code. Please check that you have entered the code displayed on the ADNGUARD sticker correctly.

statusDesc.compliant: This establishment has successfully passed all ADNGUARD DNA controls.
statusDesc.nonCompliant: The last DNA control revealed non-compliances. Certification is suspended.
statusDesc.suspended: The certification of this establishment is temporarily suspended.
statusDesc.pending: A control is currently under analysis.
statusDesc.n_existe_plus: This establishment no longer exists or has ceased operations.

history.title: DNA Control History
history.empty: No control recorded for this establishment.
